summary: BYKLE NÆRINGS SAMEIGE AS (org. no. 990 049 998) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bykle, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2006-08-08. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 294 000 and net income was NOK 7 749. CEO: Arvid Gjerden; board chair: Åsmund Hoslemo.
